memories.memory: I was diagnosed with high blood pressure in 2019 and take lisinopril every morning to keep it under control.
After my blood pressure readings reached around 165/คุณ95 in March 2024, my doctor increased my medication to 10 mg and asked me to check it at home twice a week.
I had a total knee replacement on my right knee in October 2022 after years of pain made it difficult to climb stairs at work.
I use a CPAP machine for moderate sleep apnea, although I still sometimes take it off during the night without realizing it.
My hearing has declined enough that I wear small hearing aids during meetings, especially when several people are speaking at once.
A routine colonoscopy in June 2023 found and removed two benign polyps, so my gastroenterologist wants me to repeat the procedure in five years.
Since retiring from full-time public-sector work, I have had occasional bouts of low mood and meet with a counselor once a month rather than taking an antidepressant.
